name: Phantom Ships
description: Phantom ships are spectral or mysterious vessels reported by mariners throughout history, appearing as ghostly ships that materialize and vanish at sea, often considered death omens. The most famous example is the Flying Dutchman, a legendary Dutch vessel said to be cursed to sail the oceans forever.

aliases.name: Ghost Ships
aliases.meaning: Vessels with no living crew, found adrift or appearing as spectral visions at sea

aliases.name: Flying Dutchman
aliases.region: Cape of Good Hope; global maritime tradition
aliases.meaning: The archetypal legendary ghost ship cursed to sail forever

origin: Phantom ship legends and sightings are reported globally, with the Flying Dutchman legend centered on the Cape of Good Hope and southern oceans. Real ghost ship discoveries have occurred in the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans.
